summary: A resident asks {person} to reopen a leak adjustment after the city changes its policy.
realLife: Portland agreed to reconsider a leak case under a recently adopted policy, and the homeowners received a reduction.
gates: The rule has changed and the utility can determine whether reconsideration is available.
inGame: needs: the rule has changed and the utility can determine whether reconsideration is available.

turns.what: Request a revised bill showing the result.
turns.writesBack: The revised statement records the decision on the old leak.
